single-leg-romanian-deadlift.criteria: Two dumbbells in an overhand grip. Balance on one softly bent leg, hinge with a neutral trunk while the opposite leg travels behind; return under control.

kettlebell-single-leg-deadlift.criteria: Double-kettlebell variation: one bell in each hand, one foot airborne, soft support knee and level hips. Keep the weights near the body during the hinge and return.

barbell-single-leg-romanian-deadlift.criteria: One bar with double overhand grip; hinge on one softly bent support leg with the other heel travelling backward. Keep pelvis level and return to balance.
